name: ci-red-main-fixed
about: #131 (#123/#124): main's CI was red when the PR branched off and is green now (a fix landed meanwhile). CI fails on the PR; land sees main red at the PR's base and green at its head, says so in the back-to-build reason ("rebase on main") and records main's green head. The build changes nothing, so the question recommends a rebuild (a rebase), not a rerun, which would test the same merge again. The approver's Rebuild form sends it back to build with the default note.
